_meta.description: Ethiopia's actual national AMR sentinel surveillance system data (16 sentinel sites, 2020-2024) plus a second EPHI-referred multi-pathogen MDR study (2015-2019). Two sources, two licenses - see per-record source_doi and the license notes below.

sources.source_title: A national surveillance study on five-year trends in AMR of E. coli from urine samples in Ethiopia
sources.source_authors: Abera NA, Wake SK, Geleto SE, et al.
sources.source_institution: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI), Addis Ababa - this IS the national reference laboratory that coordinates Ethiopia's 16-site AMR sentinel surveillance network
sources.license_caution: Non-commercial, No-Derivatives. Stricter than the other sources in this project (which are CC BY 4.0). Summarizing published aggregate statistics for a non-commercial educational/portfolio project is standard practice, but do not reproduce their figures/tables directly, and re-check terms before any commercial use of this project.
sources.note: This IS Ethiopia's actual national AMR surveillance system - 16 laboratory-based sentinel sites across 5 regions + 1 city administration, coordinated by EPHI as the national reference lab. Only E. coli from urine specimens covered in this paper. Values below are 5-year RANGES (min-max across 2020-2024), not per-year figures - the paper's Table 3 has exact per-year numbers but was not visible in the fetched page; only text-stated ranges are captured here.

sources.source_title: Antimicrobial resistance profiles of bacterial isolates from clinical specimens referred to Ethiopian Public Health Institute: analysis of 5-year data
sources.source_authors: Regassa BT, Tosisa W, Eshetu D, et al.
sources.source_institution: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI) - specimens referred from Addis Ababa and surrounding areas
sources.note: 840 isolates across 10+ genera, multiple specimen types (urine, blood, sputum, wound/pus, CSF, body fluid, ear/eye discharge, tracheal aspirate). Reports overall multidrug resistance (MDR, defined as resistance to >=1 antibiotic in >=3 drug classes) by organism, not per-antibiotic resistance.

study_level_context.national_sentinel_network: Ethiopia's national AMR surveillance system was established in 2017, prioritizes 6 pathogens (Klebsiella spp, Acinetobacter spp, E. coli, Pseudomonas spp, S. aureus, Enterococcus spp) from blood and urine, and reports to WHO GLASS. As of the 2026 paper, the network has 16 sentinel sites across 5 regions + 1 city administration, implemented in 3 phases (phase-I: 4 sites, phase-II: 5 sites, phase-III: 7 sites). All sites feed data to EPHI as the national reference laboratory.
sentinel_sites_named: St. Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College (SPHMMC)
Adama Public Health Research and Referral Laboratory (APHRRLC)
Nekemte Public Health Research and Referral Laboratory (NKRL)
study_level_context.gap_still_open: This national system currently only has published E. coli/urine trend data (2020-2024) in the paper found. The system also covers Klebsiella, Acinetobacter, Pseudomonas, S. aureus, and Enterococcus from blood and urine - equivalent published papers for those pathogen-specimen combinations were not found in this search and may not yet be published, or may require a separate search pass.
related_ethiopian_sources_still_not_extr: National Data Management Center for Health (EPHI) blog post on CHAMPS/SIP under-5 mortality AMR data - K. pneumoniae 9.6%-100% range, E. coli 18.2%-100% range - this is a secondary/summary source (blog, not full paper), lower confidence tier, URL: ndmc.ephi.gov.et

Ethiopian antimicrobial consumption trends in human health sector: A surveillance report 2020-2022 (PLoS One, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0319295) - this is antimicrobial CONSUMPTION (AMC) data, not resistance - relevant for a future Drug Resistance Index (DRI) feature, not evidence_records as currently schemed
